IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 1153/2025
ASHFAQUE AHMED ABDUL SATTAR SHAIKH ..APPLICANT
VS.
STATE OF MAHARASHTRA ..RESPONDENT
------------
Mr. Shaikh Abdul Kalam for the applicant.
Ms. Supriya Kak, APP for State. 
------------                                                                                                                                    
CORAM : RAJESH S. PATIL, J.
    DATE    :  APRIL 25, 2025.
 
P .C. :
1. The  learned  APP  submits  that  the  informed  had  appeared
before the Sessions Court with the advocate. She submits that the
order of the Sessions Court has not been annexed to the present
anticipatory bail application. 
2. The applicant is directed to annex the copy of the order passed
by the Sessions Court, as soon as it is made available. 
3. Stand over to 29/4/2025.
4. The learned counsel for the applicant prays for interim relief.
5. The  learned  APP  has  opposed  any  prayer  to  be  granted
1

Diksha Rane                                                                                                                                                             902 ABA 1153-2025.doc
protection to the present applicant. 
6. I  have  gone  through  the  contents  of  the  anticipatory  bail
application. As per the FIR, there are specific allegations against the
present  applicant  that  while  the  informant  on  9/4/2025  while
checking his Facebook APP , he had seen some derogative messages to
be  uploaded  by  the  present  applicant.  After  going  through  the
contents of the same, the same appeared to be filthy. The Sessions
Court after hearing the learned counsel for the applicant rejected the
pre-arrest  bail  application  filed  by  the  applicant.  The  applicant’s
mobile phone has to be recovered and checked about the derogative
messages to be uploaded by the present applicant on the Facebook.
7. In view of the same, ad-interim relief prays by the present
applicant is rejected. 
(RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)
